svg.title: Figure 2.3 · Heavy Volume, Little Progress
svg.desc: An activity-versus-result mismatch is a question to investigate, not proof of absorption or hidden intent. The three panels compare progress, activity and follow-through. Illustrative practice bars are available in the linked CSV.
